to.concept: person-profile lifecycles (stable, agreement, live, history, derived, reference, metadata)

scope: Binding revision 0.2.0 (OHC 0.1.0-draft and ODE release 0.4.0-draft.2); a conceptual comparison, never permission to convert or disclose a person's data
lost: Only stable maps to a horizon (foundation); agreement, live, history, derived, reference and metadata map to facets, time fields, Episodes, origin or envelope fields instead.
reopenWhen: Re-check when the ODE person-profile extension is released; the ODE term is from its proposed extension and is not in the pinned release schemas.
